permit.applies: The employer or an appointed employment agent applies online on the candidate's behalf (an overseas company without a Singapore-registered office, through a local sponsor), with the candidate's written consent.
permit.first: A job offer in Singapore at the EP qualifying salary, and passing the COMPASS points framework (stage 2).

fees.what: Issue of the pass, each pass

permit.eligibility: "Foreign professionals, managers and executives with a job offer in Singapore who meet the eligibility criteria" (qualifying salary, then COMPASS).
permit.pay: Fixed monthly salary from SGD 5,600 (rising with age to SGD 10,700 at 45 and above); from 1 January 2027 for new applications, SGD 6,000 rising to SGD 11,500.

sources.title: Ministry of Manpower, Employment Pass: key facts
sources.said: Foreign professionals, managers and executives with a job offer in Singapore who meet the eligibility criteria . Who can apply An employer or appointed employment agent needs to apply on behalf of the candidate. For an overseas company without a Singapore-registered office, you need to apply through a local sponsor. Qualifying salary Fixed monthly salary comparable to the top one-third of local PMET salaries, starting from $5,600 and increases progressively with age, up to $10,700 for those in the mid-40s. … First-time candidates: Up to 2 years Renewals: Up to 3 years … Is it renewable Yes.

sources.title: Ministry of Manpower, Eligibility for Employment Pass
sources.said: All (except financial services) $5,600 (increases progressively with age from age 23, up to $10,700 at age 45 and above) $6,000 (increases progressively with age from age 23, up to $11,500 at age 45 and above)

sources.title: Ministry of Manpower, Apply for an Employment Pass
sources.said: If you apply online: Processed or given an update within 10 business days. … Pay the $105 fee by GIRO, Visa, Mastercard or Amex. … Pay the fees using GIRO, Visa, Mastercard or Amex: $225 for each pass (If applicable) $30 for each Multiple Journey Visa

sources.title: Ministry of Manpower, Work Pass Exempt Activities: eligible activities
sources.said: Location filming and fashion shows Show Involvement as an actor, model, director, member of the film crew or technical crew, or photographer for: Location filming leading to TV or movie production. … You are allowed to perform a Work Pass Exempt (WPE) activity for any number of visits, but up to a total of 90 days in a calendar year (e.g. 3 stints of 30 days under WPE activities).
